summary: Design only: authoritative action resolution area (Zone.Resolving plus ordered MatchState.ResolutionArea) so a hand-played Strategy leaves Hand/HandCount at announcement. Blast radius of all Hand readers, lifecycle, view/event/replay impact, tests, risks and size. No engine change.
validation: Reproduced on current main with a failing Core test (branch claude/917-resolution-area-repro, not for merge): a Strategic Strike paused in the announce window is still in the owner's hand list and counted in HandCount. No other checks; docs only.
